summary: Executed backend API regression suite (20 pytest cases) and frontend desktop/mobile integration flows for Inc.hood demo sandbox using public URL. Core workflows passed end-to-end: start -> skip 2h -> reveal -> claim, settings/top-up/reset, filtering/navigation, responsive route rendering, and concurrency protections.

issues: Hero side label still says '5 ASSET CLASSES' instead of clearer RWA wording (e.g., '5 RWA ASSETS').
Primary button icon alignment appears visually off (left icon pushed too far); polish issue only, no functional impact.

action_items: Update Zone hero microcopy from '5 ASSET CLASSES' to RWA-specific label.
Polish dialog primary CTA icon/text alignment in modal buttons.
If strict nonblank-canvas automation is required, add an app-level render-ready test hook/data-testid instead of pixel ReadPixels checks (headless GPU sampling is noisy).
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend stylesheet is very large and monolithic (App.css). Split into route/component-level style modules for maintainability.
No backend API contract regressions found in requested scope; optimistic versioned replace logic correctly prevented duplicate charge/claim under concurrent requests.
seed_data_creation: None (used isolated demo sessions via POST /api/demo/sessions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is reusable and currently fully green (20/20). Frontend core flow passed on both 1920x800 and 390x844 with no horizontal overflow detected. Demo reset flow (cancel + confirm) validated. Canvas pixel-read checks returned zero sample hits in headless due transparent/WebGL readback behavior, while visible pod rendering exists in screenshots.
rca of the issue: Minor issues only. (1) Hero label mismatch is static copy value in Zone hero markup. (2) Modal button alignment is from dialog CTA CSS rules where leading/trailing SVGs use auto margins, which can over-separate content on some widths.
